checks.summary: A22's Firestore half, PASSED, byte-identical assertions to the memory adapter's under the same test name. The Observation lives in its own collection publication_observations keyed by the operation identifier. The per-increment read applies its bound IN THE STORAGE QUERY as a single-field equality query in exactly the Where(...).OrderBy(DocumentID).Limit(n+1) shape ExecutionByLease and RequirementIDsForRepository already use, with the extra row distinguishing a complete answer from a truncated one. Firestore indexes every single field automatically, so NO composite index is needed: firestore.indexes.json is byte-identical and git diff --stat over it is empty. The increment id is projected into the existing index_increment_id field by reading the ref through domain.ParsePublicationRef at encode time, so a record whose ref does not parse is refused at encode rather than written with an empty index.
